response.sql:
SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes AS t
JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
WHERE t.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance'
GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with a NULL equipstatus are excluded because they cannot be established as not being in 'Maintenance'.
